schema: expert_guided_selection.v1 (mirror of agent-multi tools/rl_selection_run.py @e18d00d4; only the evaluator differs)

prepare.selector_root: <package-root>/feature_selector (Musashi's checkout, src pinned by file hashes)

RECIPE.json.derivation: subset_recipe(parent, all 121) + refit_train_scaler on TRAIN 2020-01-01..2023-07-01 (bar start + 1 h); cost_mode configured; labels declared
RECIPE.json.provenance.internal_selection_bias: candidate pool used 2023; INNER_A is development, not independent confirmation

dataset.features: 121 columns of recipe v2 in order
dataset.blocks: coherent_blocks: x_sin/x_cos pairs and rg.gmm.p0/p1/p2 together

controls_first: zero_cost (DIAGNOSTIC replay of the configured-cost policy under a zero-charge profile; E3-M has no zero-cost training)

evaluator.per_task: subset recipe (empty group -> branch removed, fusion width recomputed, TRAIN-only scaler refit) -> fresh E3-M run (--recipe --action-contract C3 --trunk residual_tcn|u --seeds <seed> --split-contract consolidated --agent-state none) -> replay of the frozen policy on TRAIN and INNER_A through the engine
evaluator.score: pooled per-trade net expectancy in sigma on INNER_A with day-block bootstrap CI (stats.day_block_bootstrap_expectancy); undefined -> None with reason, never 0
evaluator.eligible: score defined AND INNER_A orders/week >= 2.0 AND early closes > 0 AND the replay reproduces the run
evaluator.reported_per_seed: profit, sharpe, max_drawdown, orders, orders_per_week, win_rate, buy/sell orders and win rates, early_closes, costs (+ components), TRAIN-INNER gap, parameter_count, fits

launch: NOT launched; tools/clean_round_chain/queue_sbfs.sh under the gate LAUNCH_EXPERT_GUIDED.json
